messages:
anna: quick question for the group — proposal to use a keyboard-expandable 'Req' badge in dense rows instead of repeating the full 'Required' word. thoughts? mike: i like the compact badge if it expands on focus. key thing: screen readers must get the full word. don't hide semantic info behind visuals. jamal: +1. Implementation: show small 'Req' token visually, but append an sr-only node like `required` inside the label so the accessible name is complete. lexi: accessibility checks: ensure the expansion is keyboard-triggered (focus) and that the expanded content is in the DOM (not CSS-only reveal) so assistive tech can read it. Also verify read order. sam: i18n note: make the token translatable and allow it to be placed before/after the label via copy tokens. some languages need different ordering. anna: ok — also want to reconfirm the inline vs summary behaviour. i'm leaning inline for single-field errors, pinned summary for cross-field/policy conflicts. summary should link to fields and move focus. mike: agreed. pattern: when summary appears, include links like `Fix replicas` that call `.focus()` on the input. For SR, also set `aria-live="polite"` on the summary container so it announces. lexi: sample pattern for field errors: set `aria-invalid="true"` and `aria-describedby=""`. reserve helper height to prevent layout shift. CSS example: `.helper { min-height: 1.125rem; }`. jamal: destructive confirmations — we should publish a small friction rubric (low/med/high). typed-confirm only for high-friction org-level ops. everything else: checkbox confirm or undo toast. sam: mobile ergonomics: typed-confirm is painful on phones. for unavoidable high-friction actions provide copy-to-clipboard and a one-tap paste affordance or let users tap the sample to prefill. lexi: accessibility for typed-confirm: give an explicit label (not placeholder) and on mismatch announce an error with `role="alert"`. snippet:```html
Text must match exactly
``` mike: nice. also include a small countdown or blocker so accidental taps don't happen. e.g., disable CTA until input matches. anna: decision draft: 1) support compact 'Req' badge that expands on keyboard focus/tap and always include sr-only required for a11y; 2) inline errors for single-field with reserved helper space; 3) pinned step summary for cross-field issues with focusable links + polite live region; 4) adopt confirmation friction rubric: typed-confirm only for high/org-level; checkbox-confirm for resource deletes; undo toast for low-risk; 5) include typed-confirm mobile aids (copy/prefill) and accessible announce pattern in docs. jamal: can frontend add a small demo showing the compact badge behavior, the summary->field focus, and a typed-confirm flow? will make rollout easier. mike: i'll open a PR with a playground. will include code + CSS + aria examples. design-bot: created issue https://redwood.internals/issue/10042 — "forms: compact badge + summary anchors + confirmation-rubric" :white_check_mark: anna: great, thanks everyone — i'll update the component tokens and file a Figma patch once the PR lands. :thumbsup:
